It is used as the stadium of Preußen Münster matches. The capacity of the stadium is 14,300 spectators. content: Plans for a new stadium for Preußen Münster date back to the late 20th century, and the project’s long and intricate history has even been documented in a book. The new main (southern) stand was already built in 2009 and will be the only element of the existing structure to be retained in the new project. The first new stand to be completed was the western stand, which opened at the start of the 2025/26 season. The stadium is home to Preußen Münster, which was founded in 1906 and was one of the founding members of the Bundesliga in 1963. ### What is the history of the Preußenstadion redevelopment plans? Instead of building a new stadium, Preußenstadion underwent modernization in 2008–2009: a completely new main (southern) stand was constructed, and the opposite stand was covered.
